result.summary: Overall layout is coherent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows generic placeholder illustrations instead of real restaurant photos and appears to list the same venue twice with identical details.

issues.description: The first two cards in the 'Fastest near you' section display a rough, generic poke-bowl illustration (scattered green/red shapes in a white bowl) instead of an actual restaurant photo. In a food-delivery context this reads as a missing or placeholder image and hurts trust and appetite appeal.
issues.suggestion: Replace the placeholder illustration with the restaurant's real food/venue photography, or show a branded fallback tile (e.g., logo on colored background) if no photo is available.

issues.description: 'Green Bowl Poké' is listed twice in the 'Fastest near you' carousel with identical name, identical '15-25 min' delivery estimate, identical €0.90 delivery fee and identical image, which looks like duplicated data rather than two distinct branches.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the entries, or if they are distinct branches, differentiate them (e.g., append neighborhood/branch name and use distinct photos and estimates).
